protocol.cpu: CPU only; start with conservative live RAM check and at most three workers, one thread each; execution resources may be reduced without changing scientific settings.
protocol.decision: argmax of class probabilities [0,1]; exact ties malignant 0
protocol.evaluation: One final test probability evaluation per fit; predictions and all clinical metrics derived from that saved array
protocol.execution_authorization: Authorized automatic queue in wdbc_automatic_queue_20261108; starts only after QSVC, classical and seven-qubit stages.
protocol.feature_maps: Z without entanglement argument; ZZ linear/full/circular (verified Pauli equivalence)
protocol.fit_access: Scaler and supervised RFE fit only original 455 raw training cases and training labels. Test transformations attached after fitting. No pilot preprocessing or pilot models reused.
protocol.interruption: No exact COBYLA restoration; preserve attempts and restart only incomplete fits from original saved initialization and seeds; fresh model/optimizer/sampler
protocol.loss: cross_entropy, installed base-2 and clipping 1e-10 semantics
protocol.ranking: Mean accuracy over exactly three valid seeds; retain every exact accuracy tie by summed correct counts; incomplete configuration summaries unavailable
protocol.selection_history: Exploratory fixed original test split with historical test-selection history; not independent validation
protocol.technical_retry: One retry for technical failures only; preserve all failed attempts
